XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Error display opening and/or closing tailgate
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: BODYWORK | B1055 | SCOOTER | DOOR | SIDE | DRIVER | DRIVING | WORKS | WINDOW | REMAINS | REMAINED | CLOSED | LOCKED | WINDOW REGULATOR |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Bodywork

  • Component: Driver’s side window regulator

  • Fault: The driver’s side window is stuck in the closed position. Occasionally, it returns to normal operation.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: B1055 (Driver’s side window motor – Open circuit)

  • Cause: Faulty driver’s side window motor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the driver’s side window regulator and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, the faulty component showed no visible defects. After replacement, the problem was permanently resolved. The motor is accessible once the door panel has been removed.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 1.3 hours.
